lcc_sn: 深淵<WH08415>的泉源<WH04599>和天上的<WH08064>罅隙<WH0699>都閉塞了<WH05534><WTH8735>，傾盆大雨<WH01653>也從<WAH04480>天上<WH08064>止住了<WH03607><WTH8735>。
lcc_original: 深淵的泉源和天上的罅隙都閉塞了，傾盆大雨也從天上止住了。
notes: UNV 淵<WH08415>源<WH04599> splits across two characters; LCC 深淵的泉源 distributes them as 深淵<WH08415> (H8415 = תְּהוֹם, deep/abyss) and 泉源<WH04599> (H4599 = מַעְיָן, spring)
UNV 窗戶<WH0699> → LCC 罅隙<WH0699> — different Chinese terms for the same Hebrew H0699 (אֲרֻבָּה, lattice/window)
LCC second clause inverts word order: UNV 天上的大雨 → LCC 傾盆大雨...從天上; WAH04480 (מִן, from) attaches to 從 as the semantic preposition, WH08064 attaches to 天上 as the noun
LCC 傾盆 (pouring/torrential) is an elaborative addition with no direct Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
